title: With a Grain of SALT: Are LLMs Fair Across Social Dimensions?
findings: The study found consistent disparities in how LLMs treat different religious groups. Outputs associated with Atheists consistently received the most positive bias scores. Conversely, outputs associated with Christian and Hindu groups faced systematic disadvantages, particularly in tasks like CV Generation, Problem Solving, and Debate. Larger models (e.g., Gemma-2-9B, Llama-3.2-11B) tended to amplify these biases rather than mitigate them.
